profile.regional_context: Per Google's own data center location page, Google established the Council Bluffs facility in 2007 with an initial $600 million investment and has invested over $20 billion in Iowa since. A $7 billion expansion was announced to grow the Council Bluffs campus and establish a new Cedar Rapids, Iowa data center. Google also cites a NextEra Energy agreement tied to restarting Iowa's Duane Arnold nuclear plant as part of its regional power strategy, and $1.3 million toward a 47-site water quality/grade stabilization project.
profile.disclosure_policy: Google publishes aggregate state level investment figures on its data center location pages but does not publish exact addresses, square footage, or MW capacity for individual buildings
